lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Noob,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: have you got any good game recommendations?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I've beaten all the ones I own, so I'm bored.
How about making your own game?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Ugh, no thanks.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Just thinking about it makes me irritated.
You have the skills though.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: How is hacking and video game production comparable?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Then again, I've never attempted it...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I suppose I could give it a shot.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It could be a game about you and the other Nikkes.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: What genre do you think would be best?
An MMORPG.
A dating sim.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You, saving the world by vanquishing hideous monsters...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You, surrounded by a harem of Nikkes...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I think I see what you're going for.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: If I do end up going through with this, I'll keep that in mind.
What about you? Is there any specific genre you want to make?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I've never given it much thought.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: How about an action shooter?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You save the world,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: becoming a decorated commander who fights off the invading Rapture hordes.
That's no different from the reality of my life now.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Reality and video games are inherently

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: two different things.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: If all of this is put inside a game though,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: it could be pretty entertaining to fight the final boss.
I doubt I could get past the first level.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Ha!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Well, if I end up making it, I'll let you know.
